18: from tslearn.utils.utils import _ts_size

20: 
21: def compute_var(p, X, with_constant=False):
22:     """Compute the VAR parameters associated with a given time series.
23: 
24:     Parameters
25:     ----------
26:         p : int
27:             AR order
28: 
29:         X : array-like, shape (sz, d)
30:             time-series data, sz should be greater or equal than p
31: 
32:         with_constant : bool (default: False)
33:             whether to compute an intercept term.
34: 
35:     Returns
36:     -------
37:         (intercept, ar_coeffs, residuals) tuple
38: 
39:     """
40:     X = check_array(X, ensure_min_samples=p)
41:     Y = X[p:]
42:     Z = np.array([X[t - p : t][::-1].ravel() for t in range(p, X.shape[0])])
43:     if with_constant:
44:         Z = np.hstack((np.ones((X.shape[0] - p, 1)), Z))
45: 
46:     coeffs, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(Z, Y, rcond=-1)
47: 
48:     intercept = np.array([])
49:     if with_constant:
50:         intercept = coeffs[0]
51: 
52:     ar_coeffs = np.array([])
53:     if p > 0:
54:         ar_coeffs = coeffs[1:] if with_constant else coeffs
55: 
56:     residuals = Y - np.dot(Z, coeffs)
57: 
58:     return intercept, ar_coeffs, residuals
59: 
60: 
61: @njit
62: def _loss(X, intercept, ar_coeffs, ma_coeffs):
63:     n_ts, n_samples, n_features_in = X.shape
64: 
65:     # Number of valid samples, discarding nans for variable length datasets
66:     n_valid_samples = np.sum(np.isfinite(np.sum(X, axis=-1)))
67: 
68:     p = ar_coeffs.shape[0]
69:     q = ma_coeffs.shape[0]
70: 
71:     sse = 0
72:     residuals = np.zeros((n_ts, q, n_features_in))
73:     start = max(p, q)
74:     for i in range(start, n_samples):
75:         current_err = X[:, i] - _varma_next(
76:             X[:, i - start : i],
77:             residuals,
78:             ar_coeffs,
79:             ma_coeffs,
80:             intercept,
81:         )
82:         # Deals with variable length series padded with nan
83:         sse += np.nansum(current_err * current_err)
84:         if q > 0:
85:             for i in range(n_ts):
86:                 if np.all(np.isfinite(current_err[i])):
87:                     residuals[i, :-1] = residuals[i, 1:]
88:                     residuals[i, -1] = current_err[i]
89: 
90:     variance = sse / (n_valid_samples - n_ts * start)
91:     n_loglikelihood = n_valid_samples * (np.log(2 * np.pi) + np.log(variance) + 1) / 2
92:     return n_loglikelihood, residuals
93: 
94: 
95: @njit
96: def _varma_next(X, residuals, ar_coeffs, ma_coeffs, intercept):
97:     n_ts, n_samples, n_features_in = X.shape
98: 
99:     ar_forecast = np.zeros((n_ts, n_features_in))
100:     for k in range(ar_coeffs.shape[0]):
101:         ar_forecast += np.dot(X[:, n_samples - k - 1], ar_coeffs[k])
102:     ma_forecast = np.zeros((n_ts, n_features_in))
103:     for k in range(ma_coeffs.shape[0]):
104:         ma_forecast += np.dot(residuals[:, k], ma_coeffs[k])
105: 
106:     intercept = np.zeros(n_features_in) if intercept.shape[0] == 0 else intercept
107: 
108:     return ar_forecast + ma_forecast + np.expand_dims(intercept, axis=0)
109: 
110: 
111: class VARIMA(TimeSeriesMixin, BaseEstimator, BaseModelPackage):
112:     """
113:     Vector AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (VARIMA) estimator [1]_.
114: 
115:     Parameters
116:     ----------
117:         p : int, (default: 1)
118:           AutoRegressive (AR) order of the model.
119:         d : int (default: 0)
120:           Differentiation order of the model.
121:         q : int (default: 0)
122:           Moving-Average (MA) order of the model.
123:         with_constant : bool (default: True)
124:           Whether the model should include an intercept term.
125:         seasonal_period: int or None (default: None)
126:           When set to a positive integer :math:`m`, the model includes
127:           a naïve seasonal integration step where :math:`x'_t = x_t - x_{t-m}`.
128:         max_iter : int (default: 50)
129:           The maximum number of iterations used while fitting the model.
130:         verbose : int (default 0)
131:           When set to a positive integer, displays logs of the iteration of the optimization.
132:           Not relevant if q=0.
133: 
134:     Attributes
135:     ----------
136:         lle_ : float
137:           Loglikelihood of the fitted model
138:         intercept_ : array-like of shape=(n_features)
139:           Intercept term of the fitted model
140:         ar_coeffs_ : array-like of shape=(p, n_features, n_features)
141:           AR coefficients of the fitted model
142:         ma_coeffs_ : array-like of shape=(q, n_features, n_features)
143:           MA coefficients of the fitted model
144: 
145:     Notes
146:     -----
147:         This estimator supports variable length time-series
148: 
149:     See Also
150:     --------
151:         AutoVARIMA: Automatic order selection of a VARIMA model
152: 
153:     References
154:     ----------
155:     .. [1] R. J. Hyndman and G. Athanasopoulos, Forecasting: Principles and Practice. OTexts, 2014.
156:       https://otexts.com/fpp3/
157: 
158:     """
159: 
160:     def __init__(
161:         self,
